### The Everlasting Covenant With David
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/everlasting-covenant-david
Passage: Jeremiah 33:14-26
Points:
- Even during impending national destruction and exile, God reassured Judah that His covenant with David was not voided.
- The promise of a righteous Branch guaranteed that David's line would sprout anew rather than end with corrupt rulers.
- Jesus Christ fulfills this prophecy eternally by serving as both the ultimate Davidic King and the great High Priest.
- Just as day and night unfailingly keep their order, God's covenant commitments are completely unbreakable.
- Believers can trust that God will faithfully carry out everything He has promised in His Word.

### Day 93: Jeremiah 33:14–22
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-93-jeremiah-33-1422.html
Passage: Jeremiah 33:14-22
Points:
- God's covenant promise to David is as permanent and reliable as the daily rhythm of light and darkness.
- Christ will visibly return in majesty to sit upon David's throne and reign as King over all the earth.
- This future fulfillment transforms grief and waiting into certainty, dancing, and everlasting praise.
- David himself will worship before the Lord and cast his own crown at Jesus' feet.
- Believers are called to set their wholehearted love and adoration upon Christ alone.
